# nemau kubernetes cluster upgrade

Upgrade the Kubernetes version.

A single task runs the preflight checks against the target version, opens a
maintenance window, then starts the upgrade. A preflight with blocking checks
fails the task. Nothing has to be opened beforehand.

The task only starts the upgrade. When it completes, the nodes are still being
replaced one by one. Follow the progress with "nemau k8s cluster get".

--version takes x.y.z, with or without a leading "v".

Requires the "kubernetes-guided-upgrades" organization feature.

## Usage

```
nemau kubernetes cluster upgrade <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --version string   target Kubernetes version, such as 1.31.2 (required)
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
